benefits.titleEn: Describe what happens during a journey
benefits.zh: drive away、drive off 和 drive on 可以幫助你描述車輛駛走或繼續行程。
benefits.en: Drive away, drive off and drive on help you describe a vehicle leaving or continuing its journey.

benefits.titleZh: 表達某人真正想說的意思
benefits.zh: 當某人沒有直接說出自己的意思時，可以使用 drive at something。
benefits.en: Drive at something is useful when a person does not express an idea directly.

benefits.titleZh: 描述人或動物離開的原因
benefits.titleEn: Describe why people or animals leave
benefits.zh: drive away、drive off 和 drive out 可以描述顧客離開、動物被趕走，或某人被迫離開某地。
benefits.en: Drive away, drive off and drive out can describe customers leaving, animals being chased away or people being forced to leave a place.

benefits.zh: 在高爾夫球運動中，drive off 表示從發球台打出開球。
benefits.en: In golf, drive off describes hitting the first shot from a tee.
